nodes.title: Harnesses never default to a server: TAXILA_BASE (or --base) must be given; tests/prod/base.mjs resolveBase refuses an empty one. A default once sent a ~19-lesson eval to production.

Gate tests wait on readiness and count work (tests/_work.mjs) instead of timing milliseconds; browser suites warm the app once before the first case. A p95 bar read 5 ms idle and 110 ms under the gate's 4-way load.
No gate test reads docs/: fixtures live in tests/fixtures, patch files are never asserted on (the code they became is). tests/gate-reads-no-docs.test.mjs enforces it.
